features.name: total_active_segments
features.description: Sum of all active segments on the display.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a continuous magnitude feature that helps the linear model separate dense patterns from sparse ones.

features.name: horizontal_active_count
features.description: Sum of the horizontal segments (top, middle, bottom).
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates a linear projection focusing on horizontal structure, useful for distinguishing patterns with strong horizontal lines.

features.name: vertical_active_count
features.description: Sum of the vertical segments (top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right).
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates a linear projection focusing on vertical structure, helping the SVM margin separate tall, vertical patterns.

features.name: right_side_active_count
features.description: Sum of the right-side vertical segments.
features.expected_model_benefit: Isolates right-aligned activation, providing a strong linear signal for patterns that heavily rely on the right side.

features.name: left_side_active_count
features.description: Sum of the left-side vertical segments.
features.expected_model_benefit: Isolates left-aligned activation, providing a strong linear signal for patterns that heavily rely on the left side.

features.name: vertical_symmetry_diff
features.description: Absolute difference between right-side and left-side active segment counts.
features.expected_model_benefit: Measures horizontal asymmetry, allowing the linear model to easily separate symmetric patterns from asymmetric ones.

features.name: horizontal_symmetry_diff
features.description: Absolute difference between top-half and bottom-half active segment counts.
features.expected_model_benefit: Measures vertical asymmetry, helping the SVM identify top-heavy or bottom-heavy patterns.

features.name: cross_interaction
features.description: Multiplicative interaction of top-left, middle, and bottom-right segments.
features.expected_model_benefit: Explicitly provides a non-linear diagonal interaction term to the linear SVM, expanding its representational capacity.

features.name: outer_ring_active_count
features.description: Sum of all segments excluding the middle segment.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures the perimeter activation, useful for distinguishing hollow patterns from filled or crossed patterns.

features.name: top_to_bottom_activation_ratio
features.description: Smoothed ratio of top-half segments to bottom-half segments.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a continuous, normalized gradient of vertical balance, highly effective for linear margin separation.

features.name: visual_complexity_score
features.description: Semantic assessment of the visual complexity of the active segments, ranging from 0.0 (very simple, few segments) to 10.0 (highly complex, many intersecting segments).
features.expected_model_benefit: Encodes human-like perception of shape complexity into a continuous scalar, providing a smooth feature for the SVM.

features.name: enclosed_loop_probability
features.description: Semantic judgment of the likelihood that the active segments form at least one fully enclosed loop.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures a high-level topological property (presence of a loop) that is difficult to express with simple linear combinations.
